--- 
title: |
  Extended Figure 1: PFS vs Fiber by Disease Type
---



```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| label: library_data_imports

library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(forestplot)
source("utility_funcs.R")

gu_cohort_data <- readRDS("../data/gu_survey_cohort.RDS")
```

The data we are visualizing here has the following structure:


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| label: load_data

gu_cohort_data <- readRDS("../data/gu_survey_cohort.RDS")

#pull out cohorts:

mUCdataFiber=filter(gu_cohort_data,cancer_type!=4)
dataUCavelumabFiber=filter(mUCdataFiber,io_regimen==5)
dataUC_NOTavelumabFiber=filter(mUCdataFiber,io_regimen!=5)

mRCdataFiber=filter(gu_cohort_data,cancer_type==4)
dataRCIpiNivoFiber=filter(mRCdataFiber,io_regimen==9 | io_regimen==17)
dataRCioTKIFiber=filter(mRCdataFiber,io_regimen==8 | io_regimen==18 | io_regimen==10 | io_regimen==11 | io_regimen==16 | io_regimen==12)

```

## Panel A

Mortality Hazard for PFS by daily average fiber density, visualized via partial smoothing spline for the GU survey cohort.  Ticks along the x axis represent individual patients. 

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| label: panel_a

makeSpline(gu_cohort_data, gu_cohort_data$pfs_mo, gu_cohort_data$pod_status, 
           gu_cohort_data$gram_fiber_per_Kcal,
           xlab = "(Grams of fiber)/(1,000 kilocalories)", ylab="Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
           title="Smoothing spline for progression-free survival",
           knots=3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5,10,15,20))

#ggsave("svg/extended_figure_1_part_a_fiber_density_spline.svg", w=8, h = 5)
```


## Panel B

Mortality Hazard for OS by daily average fiber density, visualized via partial smoothing spline for the GU survey cohortr.  Ticks along the x axis represent individual patients. 

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| label: panel_b


makeSpline(gu_cohort_data, gu_cohort_data$os_mo, gu_cohort_data$os_status, 
           gu_cohort_data$gram_fiber_per_Kcal,
           xlab = "(Grams of fiber)/(1,000 kilocalories)", ylab="Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
           title="Smoothing spline for overall survival",
           knots=3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(5,10,15,20))
#ggsave("svg/extended_figure_1_part_b_spline_os.svg", w=8, h = 5)
```

## Panel C

KM Surv Plot above below 15g/1000kcal

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| label: panel_c
kmPFS <- survfit(Surv(pfs_mo, pod_status) ~ gram_fiber_per_Kcal_aboveRecommended,
                 data = gu_cohort_data)

ggsurvplot(kmPFS,risk.table=TRUE,
           xlab="Time (months)", 
           ylab="Progression-free survival",
           pval = TRUE,
           legend=c(0.9,0.8),
           title="Patients with urothelial or renal cell cancer on ICB",
           legend.title="fiber density",
           legend.labs=c("<15 g/1,000 kcal","15+ g/1,000 kcal"),
           conf.int=TRUE,
           break.x.by=6,
           axes.offset=FALSE,
           xlim=c(0,25),
           data = gu_cohort_data)


```
